thesis: ASO has run +47% in 63 days and +15.6% in 21 days, trades above the mean analyst target (63.58), and just took a Loop Capital downgrade to Hold, so much of the good news looks priced in. The stock is rolling over from its 71.29 high (Nov 9 reversal on 3.6M shares) in a risk-off tape where QQQ is below its 50/200-day averages, the 10-year yield is at the 91st percentile and October CPI was hot, which hurts a levered consumer-discretionary retailer (debt/equity 90). Q3 earnings on 2026-12-08 fall inside the swing window, with gap risk after the run and about 20% short interest that can cut both ways. The setup only offers about 1.4 reward/risk to the first resistance at 71.29, and the pre-market quote above the entry zone invites chasing. A close back under SMA20 (63.4) would turn this into a failed breakout.
